messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered: KMS decrypt errors surge in us-west-2 (integration: kms-service). Incident ID: INC-2026-0426-7. Users impacted: API token decrypts failing ~80% for a subset of requests. Paging alex (primary on-call) and ryan (secondary).

pagerduty: PagerDuty: alex acknowledged the incident (1m ago). Escalation -> ryan in 10m if unacked.

alex: on it. jumping in. any context on which key?

maria: seeing a spike of 429 / RateLimitExceeded from our KMS provider + a bunch of KeyNotFound errors for rotation versions. Rolling key rotation started ~03:50 UTC.

ryan: key rotation? we just rolled v4 -> v5 for customer master key cmk-app-prod, could be mismatch. are requests still referencing v4?

emily: telemetry: ~95% of decrypt failures show error codes: "KeyNotFoundException" and ~30% show "ServiceThrottledException". Affected paths: token-decrypt, session-store, svc-auth.

alex: grabbing recent logs.

alex: paste of logs (truncated):
```
2026-04-26T03:56:12Z svc-auth ERROR decrypt failed keyId=cmk-app-prod:v5 error=KeyNotFoundException
2026-04-26T03:56:12Z svc-auth WARNING retrying decrypt keyId=cmk-app-prod:v4
2026-04-26T03:56:13Z kms-proxy ERROR upstream returned 429 ServiceThrottledException quota=500 rps used=622
2026-04-26T03:56:14Z token-service ERROR decrypt failed keyId=cmk-app-prod:v5 error=KeyNotFoundException
```

maria: looks like clients got deployed with references to v5 but KMS only has v4 active for some partitions, and the KMS provider is throttling on the rotation work. Could be our rotation orchestration hit the provider hot path.

alex: first mitigation: switch token-service to fallback cache for 5 mins so we avoid immediate customer-facing failures. rolling restart to pick fallback flag.

ryan: +1. I have a patch to enable local-kv fallback in token-service. Pushing now to a small canary.

incident-bot: action logged: alex enabled local fallback for token-service on canary (3m ago). Notifying SRE.

emily: results from canary: decrypt errors dropped from 82% -> 6% for canary traffic, latency stable. No data loss.

alex: good. can we route traffic to canary group while we investigate KMS state? set traffic split 10% -> canary.

ops-bot: runbook step triggered: open KMS provider support ticket / escalate to account team. Ticket created: SUP-87921.

maria: contacting provider support now. initial response says they're investigating throttling in us-west-2 caused by high volume of key version create/list operations during rotation.

ryan: while provider is looking, we should stop the rotation job. I see the orchestration batch is still progressing - pausing it.

alex: pausing rotation job (orchestration ID rot-2026-04-26-12). Confirmed paused.

emily: telemetry: after pause + fallback + 10% canary routing, errors across traffic dropped to ~15% (from 82%). Expected to decline further as more traffic gets fallback.

maria: note: some long-lived tokens still reference v5 and will hit KeyNotFound until we either provision v5 or roll references back. Options: 1) finish rotation once provider clears throttling, 2) revert deployed references to v4 (but requires deploy & risk), 3) include a server-side lookup map to translate v5 -> v4 for decrypt.

alex: short term: expand fallback to 50% traffic, keep rotation paused, and create a server-side translation map in token-service to rewrite incoming version tags v5->v4 for affected customers.

ryan: implementing translation map now. will return a follow-up in 8-10m with rollout cadence.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: ryan acknowledged escalation (5m after initial ack).

emily: provider update: Support says they see a backlog and are increasing throttle limits, but it could take up to 45 minutes to fully clear. They recommend we avoid repeated list/create operations.

alex: ok. no more rotation operations. stop any automation touching KMS versions.

maria: I've pinned a circuit-breaker on our KMS proxy to fast-fail high-volume version-list calls and queue them for retry over an exponential backoff. Patch deployed to proxy canary.

ryan: translation map ready. config snippet:
```
translation_map:
  cmk-app-prod:
    v5: v4
```
rolling to 10% -> 30% -> 50% over 20 minutes.

alex: start rollout to 10% now. monitor user errors and latency.

ops-bot: note: customer impact: auth errors affecting login and API token refresh for ~18% of users in us-west-2. SLOs degraded for token-refresh endpoint. Logging incident severity: Sev2.

emily: observability: created dashboard panel for KeyNotFound rate, KMS 429 rate, and token refresh success rate.

maria: provider updated: throttle relief in progress, some queues drained, they expect normal within ~18 minutes.

ryan: translation map at 10% now. early telemetry: KeyNotFound errors in that bucket -> near zero.

alex: moving to 30% now.

emily: 30% -> errors down cluster-wide to ~9%. Good trend.

alex: reaching out to product and support with a short user-visible advisory: token refresh failures in us-west-2, workarounds in place, monitoring. who can draft?

maria: I can draft the advisory and post to status.redwood.ai. keep it factual, say mitigations applied and ETA for full recovery unknown but estimated < 1 hour.

ops-bot: handoff note: alex -> ryan in 18 minutes (routine on-call rotation). Ensure runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/kms-rotation.

ryan: I'll take over for the remainder. current actions for oncall: 1) continue translation map rollout to 50%, 2) monitor provider updates, 3) coordinate rollback or resume of rotation once provider confirms safe window, 4) postmortem owners: alex + ryan.

alex: thanks. added postmortem stub: https://docs.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0426-7. assign severity, timeline and follow-ups.

incident-bot: Summary: mitigation in place (local fallback + translation map), rotation paused, provider engaged (SUP-87921). Current impact: residual token refresh failures for small percentage of requests. Next update in 15m or on major status change.

emily: tentative timeline: if provider clears throttles in ~18m we can safely finish rotation with a controlled batch. otherwise we keep rotation paused and use translation map until we can plan safer rollout.

ryan: ack. I'll post an update when translation map hits 50% or provider gives all-clear.

alex: great work team. please add any offline follow-ups to the postmortem doc.

maria: creating JIRA: KMS-462 (investigate rotation orchestration hot-path + safe-guard).

ops-bot: incident status updated: ongoing -> mitigation stage.

ryan: update: translation map at 50% (20m after initial). KeyNotFound errors dropped to ~2% globally. Keeping rotation paused.

incident-bot: Last logged event: 1769801840 - translation map at 50% and rotation still paused.
